decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, 01,02,03Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The glazing serving ground floor en-suit of the development indicated on drawing No 03; shall be fixed shut and in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.
description: Conversion of garage into habitable room involving alterations to front elevation and additional window at ground floor side elevation.
